parts.tooltip: fmap f :: Parser a ⟶ Parser (Parser b)\nOn success (a, rest) returns (f a, rest): the next parser is built but not yet run. Failure stays Nothing.

join :: Parser (Parser b) ⟶ Parser b — the Parser-specific part
join pp = \input -> case pp input of
  Nothing        -> Nothing       -- propagate failure
  Just (p, rest) -> p rest        -- run the inner parser on the remainder

ports.tooltip: Parser a = String ⟶ Maybe (a, String) — run on input; succeeds with (a, rest) or fails with Nothing
f : a ⟶ Parser b — user code; given parsed value a, constructs the next parser
Parser b — the composed parser; on success returns (b, rest2) where rest2 is what f(a) didn't consume. Never Parser (Parser b).
